Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Vintage Window Mirror -28 Inch, Antique Grey Blue
Materials: iron
Complete your room with this beautifully simple antique-blue/grey mirror. Arriving ready to hang, this mirror has a durable iron frame and a distressed finish that creates a vintage look. Its modern take on the classic antique-mirror design makes this mirror perfect for transitional-style home décor. 28.15"H x 18.3"W x 0.98"D Mirror glass with an iron frame This casual mirror's antique styling blends well with both modern and vintage home-décor styles. No hanging materials needed
